name: smwmusic-wario-master-of-disguise-count-cannoli-battle
title: Wario: Master of Disguise - Count Cannoli Battle
description:
The wonderful battle song you hear when fighting count Cannoli in WMoD. Can fit mid-bosses, since it's kind of repetitive and short, yet memorable.
Watch out with noise SFX in your levels, since the song uses noise.
